description: Capabilities for the Centinelo Phone main window - custom titlebar controls + tray-driven show/hide + the auto-updater's read-only check (updater:allow-check) and its post-install relaunch (process:allow-restart), PLUS every one of this app's own `generate_handler!` commands the main-window frontend actually invokes (js/app.js, js/console-panel.js, js/error-capture.js/error-reporting.js). The inline receptionist console panel (console-panel.js, mounted INSIDE this window since 2.1.0 - see docs/console-inline-panel-decision.md) is why the sidecar_hold/resume/mute/*_transfer/blf_subscribe/blf_unsubscribe entries are here even though the always-on main UI doesn't call them itself. Everything NOT listed below is denied to this window by build.rs's AppManifest (see build.rs's APP_COMMANDS comment) - most notably admin_lock, transcription_manual_stop, premium_info, premium_diagnostic and the hid_* commands, which are registered in generate_handler! but not yet invoked from any shipped frontend, and the whole admin/license/provisioning surface is intentionally scoped to just this window, never to `console` (see capabilities/console.json's description for why that split matters).
